edge.title: PMuon: NS(L^-γ·u·R^-γ) with streaming covariance powers (γ=0.3)
edge.summary: PMuon inserts a two-sided preconditioner between momentum and Newton–Schulz: the step becomes NS(A^-0.3·u·C^-0.3)·max(1,m/n)^0.5, where C and A are β=0.95 running sums of uᵀu (n×n) and uuᵀ (m×m). The inverse matrix powers come from one warm-started QR subspace iteration per step (eigenbasis kept in optimizer state, Rayleigh-quotient eigenvalues), so directions with a large accumulated second moment on either side are damped before orthogonalization — Muon's polar step taken in a covariance-whitened geometry. lr 0.035, wd 0.025 and mu 0.95 are inherited from #12 without retuning; train_steps drops 3350→3250, claimed at 3225.

changes.label: Two-sided covariance accumulators
changes.detail: pmuon_update: after the Nesterov blend (which overwrites grad in place), cov_buf ← 0.95·cov_buf + uᵀu and out_buf ← 0.95·out_buf + uuᵀ; it returns C = uᵀu + 0.95·cov_buf + 1e-6·I and A built the same way on the left.

changes.label: Streaming inverse power via QR
changes.detail: _streaming_cov_power: Q (random orthogonal at first use, then persisted as cov_Q/out_Q) ← qr(C·Q) once per step; λ = diag(QᵀCQ) clamped 1e-6; returns Q·diag(λ^-γ)·Qᵀ rescaled to Frobenius norm √n.

changes.label: Preconditioned polar step
changes.detail: Muon.step now computes update = NS(A_neg @ u @ C_neg) · max(1,m/n)^0.5, then the usual p *= 1−lr·wd and p −= lr·update; gamma=0.3 and beta=0.95 are constructor defaults.

changes.label: train_steps 3350 → 3250, claim 3225
changes.detail: Linear cooldown (frac 0.7) now ends at 3250; 3225 is a 25-step late validation point.

edge.parent_check: consistent — nearest-code is #12 and every other hyperparameter (lr 0.035, wd 0.025, mu 0.95, aux AdamW, cooldown 0.7) is unchanged, as the README states.
edge.noise: None of note beyond replacing muon_update by pmuon_update; the gamma argument passed to pmuon_update is unused there.

hparams.pmuon.factor_dims: right n×n and left m×m (up to 3072×3072 for MLP matrices)

mechanisms.name: PMuon (bilateral streaming covariance-power preconditioning)
mechanisms.explain: Per hidden matrix the optimizer keeps un-normalized running sums R ← 0.95R + uᵀu (n×n) and L ← 0.95L + uuᵀ (m×m) of the Nesterov momentum u, forms C = uᵀu + 0.95R + 1e-6·I (and A likewise), and tracks each one's eigenbasis with a single QR step Q ← qr(C·Q) per optimizer step, warm-started from the previous Q. With Rayleigh quotients λ = diag(QᵀCQ) it builds Q·diag(λ^-0.3)·Qᵀ (rescaled to Frobenius norm √n) and steps along NS(A^-0.3·u·C^-0.3)·max(1,m/n)^0.5 with decoupled WD. With no history (only the current uᵀu, uuᵀ) the pre-NS matrix would be UΣ^(1−4γ)Vᵀ and NS would return Muon's UVᵀ, so the change comes entirely from the accumulated covariance tilting the polar step.

caveats: The README defines the covariances on the raw gradient (R_t = βR_{t−1} + GᵀG), but in code grad.lerp_ overwrites p.grad with the Nesterov blend first, so the statistics are of u; C/A also count the current term twice ((1+β)·uᵀu + β²·R_{t−1}) and are unnormalized sums (scale is irrelevant after the √n normalization and NS). The eigenbasis is only approximately tracked (one QR iteration per step from a random start), and the m×m / n×n factors include 3072×3072 matrices for both MLP weights, refreshed every step (slow but allowed).
